auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/12/8), with 6 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 11 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing National Standing reached (Fight 8 · Forage 6 · Craft 6 · Talk 17 · Explore 47 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Sigrun Eiriksdottir ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

ladderLines.line: It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.

✨ CAPSTONE: Seed Vault. Every seed you have ever pocketed, kept dry and dreaming. It weighs almost nothing. Almost. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
